Opens lookerstudio.google.com in a new tab. Building your private copy can take up to ~10 seconds, and the tab may briefly show an error page while Google provisions the report — don’t close it. One dialog is different: if the tab says “This report isn’t shared with you”, waiting will not fix it — see the note below.

This page has no backend. It sends no identifiers or credentials to the template owner; it only creates a Google Looker Studio URL. Verify in this page’s source.

01

Enter your table ID

Paste or type the fully qualified ID of the base table configured for the ADK BigQuery Agent Analytics plugin Prompt & Response Logging on your Conversational Analytics data agents — project.dataset.table, one value naming all three.

02

Review in Google

The new tab may briefly show a loading or “not found” page while Google provisions your copy — don’t close it. (A dialog quoting “This report isn’t shared with you” is not that flicker; see below.) Looker Studio then shows an acknowledgement dialog. It appears because you’re about to create a data source that runs a SQL query this page supplied — read the exact query read the exact query. The dialog lists that query, your billing project, and that the new data source initially uses Owner’s Credentials; nothing is created until you acknowledge it. The query reads only your table, using the opener’s credentials, in your billing project.

03

Save, then secure sharing

Choose “Edit and share” to save it. Before sharing, set the new data source’s credentials to Viewer’s Credentials so every viewer must have their own BigQuery access.

Dedicated 7-page tool-free BQCA Looker Studio template — Template not yet publicly shared for external accounts. Public link sharing (allUsers) for the dedicated 7-page tool-free BQCA report template (1ffb0888-20ea-451f-aeb8-69fc37973335, data source alias ds0) is currently pending cross-organization allowlisting and external copy verification. Until external link sharing is active, opening the 1-click Looker Studio link from an external Google account can show “This report isn’t shared with you”; use the self-hosted Streamlit dashboard or standalone custom SQL query below to explore your BQCA logs immediately. The template covers Token Consumption, Data Agents & Turns, LLM Interactions & Embedding Suggestions, User & Persona Analytics, Latency & Fast-Path ROI, Errors (BQCA 3-Condition), and Prompt, Response & SQL Inspector (all tool-usage pages, tool-latency series, and tool-error charts are omitted).
Advanced CLI & self-hosted options

Run the Self-Hosted Streamlit BQCA Dashboard (dashboards/streamlit/) or export the BQCA reporting query bound to your table with hydrate_dashboard.py --profile bqca --custom-sql-out.

“This report isn’t shared with you” is not a setup error. That dialog is terminal — it offers Reload / Return to report list / Go to report template and does not resolve by waiting. It means the shared dashboard template is unavailable to the Google account signed in to that tab; nothing is wrong with your project, dataset, table, IAM setup, or the identifiers you entered. First confirm the tab is using the account you intend (Looker Studio uses the browser’s default Google account). If you are signed in with an organization-managed account, your own organization’s sharing policy can also block receiving Looker Studio assets from external domains — try a personal account if you can. If the dialog still persists, the template’s copy path is blocked — report it on issue #445 track public-sharing allowlist progress on #515 — say only whether the signed-in account is personal or part of an organization; do not post the account’s email address. The repository’s CLI preflight can still validate your table, but it copies the same template, so it is not a workaround; while the template is blocked, use the Grafana dashboardSelf-Hosted Streamlit BQCA Dashboard or hydrate_dashboard.py --profile bqca --custom-sql-out.
Keep the new report private until the credential check. The Linking API creates a data source owned by the person opening the link and its review dialog can show Owner’s Credentials. In the saved report, open Resource → Manage added data sources → Edit and verify Data credentials: Viewer before sharing. Learn about Looker Studio data credentials.
Required security check

Before you share the new report

The Linking API creates a new data source owned by the person who opens the link. Keep the report private until these checks pass.

  1. Select Edit and share to save your copy.
  2. Keep the report private while configuring its data source.
  3. Open Resource → Manage added data sources → Edit.
  4. Set Data credentials to Viewer’s Credentials.
  5. Test the report with an account that has only viewer access.
No generated views required. The dashboard reads the configured BQAA event table BQCA logging table directly. A separate billing project is available under Advanced settings. For a location override or verified preflight, use the repository’s CLI helper.
Desktop viewing. Designed for desktop screens at least 1280 px wide. On a cold load or after changing pages, native charts may paint after the surrounding report controls; allow up to 90 seconds before treating a chart as failed. A responsive mobile template is not part of v1.
